details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:908-912 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `hold_request` op is skipped (`reason=report_unauthenticated`) whenever the heal report was sent without an OIDC identity.
  WHY: `WORKFLOW_HEAL_REQUIRE_REPORT_AUTH` defaults to false in scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:271, so the intake can still file the report, and the project then gets no hold marker. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 gave no severity, openai_gpt-6-luna gave MAJOR.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:540,905,915 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `heal_report` skip line (540) and `hold_request` skip lines (905, 915) omit `issue=` (and `label=` on line 540). agents.d/validation-harness-routing-p3.md:2 documents these as contractual log shapes.
  WHY: Log consumers keyed on the documented shape miss the most common skip lines. Severity is NIT per sonnet, qwen and glm. Gemini and minimax gave no severity.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:568 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `op=heal_report ... runs=unavailable` log line (568) has no `outcome=` or `reason=`. minimax_minimax-m3 also notes line 600 (the identity status line) has neither.
  WHY: Parsers keyed on the documented `outcome=` shape misread or miss the line. Severity is NIT per qwen and glm (glm confidence 3). minimax gave no severity.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:661-750 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Gemini claims `unblock_run_ops` may use a stale `issue` variable for `hold_request`. Three other reviewers (sonnet, qwen, glm) checked and refuted this: `issue` is re-read from the current op at line 662.
  WHY: Gemini states a stale or unset `issue` could misdirect `hold_request`. No severity was given, so medium is inferred.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:538-540 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The heal report is dispatched without an OIDC identity (marked unauthenticated), but the intake is claimed to require OIDC. The hold is then skipped, so the project proceeds unheld.
  WHY: Gemini says the project proceeds without a hold while a harness fix may be pending, which can cause cascading failures. No severity was given, so medium is inferred.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:665-680 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Error handling for earlier op failures differs between `heal_report` and `hold_request`.
  WHY: Gemini says a following `hold_request` might not trigger correctly or might use stale information. minimax checked this and found the failure branches consistent. No severity was given, so medium is inferred.
- agents.d/validation-harness-routing-p3.md:2 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The documented `UNBLOCK_TARGET_REPO_GUARD` log shape is inconsistent with the `issue=`/`label=` fields the implementation emits (or omits) on `heal_report` skip lines.
  WHY: Stable log consumers keyed on the documented shape fail to parse these lines. No severity was given, so medium is inferred.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Carry out `heal_report` and send one `repository_dispatch` to coding-workflows. The producer contract in scripts/unblock_actions.py:92-99 says the report is sent "also for a pull request."
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_send_heal_report() (lines 552-559). minimax also names scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py, REPORT_IDENTITY_WORKFLOW_BY_KIND (lines 422-428).
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The `.pull_request` check at scripts/unblock_judge.sh:552-558 returns `pull_request_item` without dispatching, tests/test_unblock_judge.py:4755-4761 asserts that PR items send no report, REPORT_IDENTITY_WORKFLOW_BY_KIND["pull_request"] still allows only `workflow_failure_heal.yml`. Severity: BLOCKER per gemini, MAJOR per minimax and luna. Sonnet, qwen and glm treat the skip as a documented design choice, not a gap.
- requirement: Log `UNBLOCK_TARGET_REPO_GUARD item=... outcome=<consumer|harness|mixed|disabled> paths=...`
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_run_ops
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: Gemini says `unblock_log_target_repo_guard` is never called in the main loop of `unblock_run_ops` and appears only in the `unblock_project_terminal_recheck` branch. Severity MAJOR. sonnet, qwen and glm refute this: the function is called at line 2019/2022 after planning and before `unblock_run_ops`.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:540,905,915 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: These log lines omit `issue=` (and `label=` for the `heal_report` skip), which agents.d/validation-harness-routing-p3.md documents as contractual.
  WHY: Consumers matching the documented shape miss the common skips. The tests match the short form. Only observability is affected.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:661-750 (unblock_run_ops) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The unblock judge logic for `hold_request` and `heal_report` does not correctly map the `issue` variable, which is local to the function.
  WHY: `issue` may be stale from a previous iteration or never updated if an op lacks the `issue` field.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:538-540 (unblock_send_heal_report) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: With a missing OIDC identity the heal report is dispatched anyway but marked unauthenticated, while the intake requires OIDC.
  WHY: `hold_request` is skipped when `heal_unauth` is true, but the intake rejects the report, so the project proceeds unheld.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:665-680 (unblock_run_ops) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Error handling for earlier failures is inconsistent: `heal_report` sets `heal_skip_reason` and logs, while `hold_request` logs an error and sets `ops_failed`.
  WHY: A following `hold_request` might not trigger correctly or might use stale information.
- agents.d/validation-harness-routing-p3.md:2 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `UNBLOCK_TARGET_REPO_GUARD` log documentation is inconsistent with the `issue=`/`label=` fields the implementation emits on `heal_report` skip lines.
  WHY: Stable log consumers keyed on the documented shape fail to parse these lines.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Carry out `heal_report` ... The heal_report contract also applies to pull requests (scripts/unblock_actions.py, lines 92-99)."
  Expected change site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_send_heal_report()
  Evidence of absence: It skips every item whose JSON contains .pull_request at lines 552-558, and tests/test_unblock_judge.py lines 4755-4761 assert that a PR item sends no report.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Log `UNBLOCK_TARGET_REPO_GUARD item=... outcome=<consumer|harness|mixed|disabled> paths=...`
  Expected change site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_run_ops
  Evidence of absence: `unblock_log_target_repo_guard` is defined but never called in the main loop of `unblock_run_ops`. It appears only in the `unblock_project_terminal_recheck` branch.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:908-912 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The project hold is made conditional on the report carrying an OIDC identity, but the intake's default (`REQUIRE_REPORT_AUTH` false, scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:271) accepts unauthenticated reports.
  WHY: In the default configuration the heal issue is filed but the hold marker never reaches the tracking issue. The poller then records no hold, adds no `ai:harness-broken` label, posts no comment and does not resume the project automatically.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:540,905 (contract at agents.d/validation-harness-routing-p3.md:2) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The skip line at 540 carries no `issue=` or `label=`, and the `hold_request` skip at 905 carries no `issue=`. Two further `op=heal_report` lines (568 `runs=unavailable`, 600 the identity status) carry neither `outcome=` nor `reason=`.
  WHY: A consumer keyed on the documented shape silently misses the most common skip and failure lines, and a state machine that switches on `outcome=` sees an empty value.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Carry out `heal_report`: build the payload ..., wrap it (`wrap-dispatch`), attach the identity (`request-report-identity`) and send one `repository_dispatch` (`workflow-failure-heal`) to coding-workflows." Also "Depends on P3a", whose op contract at scripts/unblock_actions.py:92-98 says the report is sent "also for a pull request".
  Expected change site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, `unblock_send_heal_report()` (lines 552-559) and scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py, `REPORT_IDENTITY_WORKFLOW_BY_KIND` (lines 422-428).
  Evidence of absence: The judge refuses every item with `pull_request` (`jq -e '.pull_request'` at scripts/unblock_judge.sh:555). tests/test_unblock_judge.py:4755-4761 pins that refusal, and README.md:3907-3909 documents it. `REPORT_IDENTITY_WORKFLOW_BY_KIND["pull_request"]` is still `("workflow_failure_heal.yml",)`. Both files are inside the issue's `files_touched`.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:597-621, unblock_send_heal_report): The OIDC token file and the dispatch body are removed only on the explicit return paths, so a cancel or timeout leaves them in `${RUNNER_TEMP}/unblock-judge`. Suggested fix: add an EXIT trap, about 1 line. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:909-912 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A report sent without an OIDC identity always causes the project `hold_request` to be skipped.
  WHY: `WORKFLOW_HEAL_REQUIRE_REPORT_AUTH` defaults to false (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:271), so the intake can accept an unauthenticated report, yet the judge skips the hold unconditionally when `heal_unauth=true`.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Carry out the planned `heal_report` operation and send one `repository_dispatch`; the producer contract says the report is sent "also for a pull request."
  Expected change site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_send_heal_report()
  Evidence of absence: The `.pull_request` check at lines 552-558 returns `pull_request_item` without dispatching, and tests/test_unblock_judge.py:4755-4761 asserts that PR items send no report.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- agents.d/validation-harness-routing-p3.md:2 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The documented `hold_request` log shape says `issue=` is always present, but line 905 of scripts/unblock_judge.sh logs `op=hold_request outcome=skip reason=no_heal_report` without it.
  WHY: Log consumers keyed on the documented shape will not match the `no_heal_report` skip line.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:568 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The log line `op=heal_report issue=${issue} label=${label} runs=unavailable` lacks the documented `outcome=` and `reason=`. It is also redundant with line 585, which logs `outcome=failed reason=runs_unavailable`.
  WHY: Consumers keyed on the documented shape will not match it, and the duplicate log makes it unclear whether the runs-listing failure is a warning or a failure.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-
